Planned: one free trial per eligible NIKNOLIG account lasting five consecutive 24-hour periods from the first explicitly confirmed, successful server-side Defense activation. No payment method required. Reinstalling, changing devices or switching platforms does not restart the trial.

Additionally, a separate 48 hours of free Defense access is intended for people demonstrably unable to get themselves out of an emergency. It must not be blocked solely because the trial expired or payment is missing. The specific safe, data-minimizing verification has not been defined.

Neither a trial nor emergency access starts here. Activation time, remaining time and expiration are unavailable without secure account synchronization. Trial activation, emergency verification, purchase and restoration are not connected yet.

After the regular trial expires, an optional permanent upgrade for a one-time €0.75 payment is planned for the same account on supported platforms. No subscription, automatic renewal, recurring charges or automatic payment. A purchase requires your explicit confirmation in the store; the final total price including taxes must be confirmed beforehand. NIKNOLIG remains usable without the upgrade.

Security, emergency and infrastructure-discovery features are unavailable in this preview. An upgrade does not guarantee emergency assistance. In immediate danger, use the local emergency number.

This preview has no protection or emergency-calling feature and does not share your location. It does not replace local emergency services. If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services directly using the applicable emergency number.
Choose how Elektro-Engel should explain things and whether simple feedback may be counted locally.

People have feelings—technology should support people, not decide for them. Elektro-Engel defaults to brief replies, asks when unsure, and takes extra care with important topics. Feedback never changes answers automatically.
YOUR DATA STAYS ON THIS DEVICE

This preview stores your explanation-style choice and—only after you opt in—aggregate feedback counts. A session summary stores only what you deliberately enter. Conversation transcripts, timestamps, and device identifiers are not stored or transmitted. Everything stays on this device until you delete it or uninstall the app. The counters do not train a model or change answers.
Preview: Open Settings, select Bluetooth, and check whether Bluetooth is turned on. You can then see available devices nearby.
